name: Trust Dynamics
motto: Name the stubs. Invent no scores.
function: Shadow typed stub for trust assessment / state / update. Accepts ordered trustEvents and priorTrustState. Placeholder types stay NOT_COMPUTABLE. Does not invent trust scores, schema engines, or Forecast influence.
constraints: Code-bind override of Drift stub ACTIVE/DIRECT
Distinct from RUNE.TRUST_CUE_SCAN (no merge, alias, or reuse)
Placeholder types TrustEvent, TrustState, TrustAssessment, TrustUpdate, OutcomeLink stay NOT_COMPUTABLE
No Forecast DIRECT path or weighting
Declared deps FORECAST_SCORE, DRIFT, ERS, CONTINUITY are unbound
Weak or missing inputs yield nulls plus NOT_COMPUTABLE / trust_not_computable
Deterministic: identical ordered trustEvents + identical priorTrustState yield identical output
canonical_statement: RUNE.TRUST (TRU) is a Shadow typed stub. It accepts ordered trustEvents and priorTrustState, emits null-safe TrustAssessmentStub / TrustStateStub / TrustUpdateStub with NOT_COMPUTABLE / trust_not_computable, and does not invent scores, merge TRUST_CUE_SCAN, or influence Forecast.

metadata.determinism_rule: same priorTrustState + same events (ordered) + same decay parameters → identical updated TrustState
